## Editor's briefing
- Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt to buy AI chips arriving in 2027, though Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still under way.
- SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special board committees of independent directors to review a possible merger; no terms have been agreed.
- Musk said Starship Flight 15, which is set to attempt the first tower catch of the ship itself, could fly within about four to six weeks of mid-October.
- Grok released the first seven minutes of its AI-generated 'Odyssey' series, and Starlink service in Ukraine is back to normal after a weeklong disruption.

## Projects in motion (reviewed 2026-10-26)
- **Starship** (SpaceX) — stage 2/4, TESTING: Flight 15 to attempt the first ship catch, targeted for about late November; FAA reviewing a higher Texas launch rate.
- **Starlink V3** (SpaceX) — stage 4/4, SCALING: 10,000+ satellites; V3 satellites now flying on Starship.
- **Cybercab & Robotaxi** (Tesla) — stage 3/4, RAMP: First Cybercab rides reported alongside Q3 2026 results.
- **Optimus** (Tesla) — stage 2/4, PILOT: Output targeted toward the end of 2026.
- **Telepathy & Blindsight** (Neuralink) — stage 2/4, TRIALS: Next-generation implant with more channels unveiled in October.
- **Grok & orbital compute** (SpaceX · xAI) — stage 2/4, SHIPPING: $40B in debt closed for GPUs arriving in 2027; Grok releasing an AI-generated video series.

## Quick facts
- SpaceX: founded 2002; listed on Nasdaq as SPCX on 12 June 2026.
- Starship: fully reusable launch system; third-generation V3 first flew in May 2026.
- Starlink: first satellites launched in 2019; more than 10,000 active.
- Tesla: Elon Musk has been CEO since 2008; Nasdaq: TSLA.
- xAI: founded 2023; combined with SpaceX in February 2026.
- Neuralink: founded 2016; first human implant in 2024.
- The Boring Company: founded 2016.
